html:
Konfrontasi was an undeclared war from 1963 to 1966 in which Indonesia, under Sukarno, tried to break up the new federation of Malaysia. Most fighting took place along the jungle border in Borneo.

Sukarno called Malaysia a British puppet. Indonesian troops and volunteers raided Sarawak and Sabah, and small landings were made on the Malay Peninsula. British, Gurkha, Australian and New Zealand troops fought beside Malaysian forces.

The conflict ended after Suharto pushed Sukarno aside. In 1967 Indonesia and Malaysia were founding members of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, whose habit of avoiding open quarrels grew from this experience.
